documents.name: customer_demographics
documents.text: Customer demographics. Customer types. Customer segments. Customer categories. Customer classification. Segmentation of customers. Kinds of customers. Customer groups and the description of each group. Contains the customer type identifier and a description of that customer type.

Customer type ID. Customer type code. Customer segment ID. Customer category code. Customer group identifier. The short code that uniquely identifies a customer type or segment. Used to link a customer to the segment they belong to.
Customer type description. Customer segment description. Description of the customer group. What the customer type means. Free text describing the customer segment or demographic category.
